periods.analysis: Six community screening events and 540 vaccine doses at free clinics gave us a steady start, with winter respiratory clinics carrying most of the vaccination volume.
periods.recommendations: Bring blood pressure checks to faith partner sites and plan spring catch-up immunization clinics.

periods.analysis: Screening events nearly doubled to 11 as faith partners hosted blood pressure checks. Vaccine doses rose only to 610 once respiratory season ended, so we have scheduled back-to-school clinics to lift volume.
periods.recommendations: Run back-to-school immunization clinics and add diabetes screening at the Bayfront farmers market.

periods.analysis: Screening events and vaccination clinics expanded steadily through the summer, and the fall respiratory season clinics are already on the calendar. Partnering with faith communities and employers has made it easier to reach adults who do not have a regular clinic. The next step is tracking follow-up care so a positive screening leads to a visit.
periods.recommendations: Track follow-up care after screenings and complete the fall clinic calendar.
